why: In section 1 the reader writes "Not sure what 86,492 really means. It says 'בערכים ריאליים'… I couldn't tell if that's bad or just 'in today's money.'" In section 5 they ask whether 86,492 is already after inflation. That is a finding that "ריאליים" is unclear, not doubt about the figure. It is the first page problem in the report; the earlier lines in section 1 explain the reader's choice.
